about_the_game:
Arcadia: Cloudbound

Arcadia: Cloudbound is a 3D spot-the-difference game that invites you to slow down and explore beautiful, fully rotatable scenes. Each level presents a carefully crafted 360° 3D environment where you search for five hidden differences. Some are easy to notice, while others reward patience, curiosity, and careful observation.

The game is designed to be relaxing rather than stressful. There are no fast timers pushing you forward. Instead, Arcadia encourages you to take your time, rotate the scene, and enjoy the details from every angle.

Key Features:

Artistic and Visual Experience:

Every part of Arcadia is created with a strong focus on art and atmosphere. From the handcrafted 3D models and detailed environments to the clean user interface and calm background music, the game aims to create a visually pleasing and comfortable space for players to explore.

Explore in Full 360 Degrees:

You can freely rotate each scene and examine it from any direction. Some differences can only be discovered by changing your viewpoint, making exploration an important part of the experience.

Varied and Interactive Gameplay:

In addition to classic spot-the-difference challenges, Arcadia includes more than ten mini-games. Some differences involve simple puzzle interactions, adding variety and a sense of discovery to each level.

Expansive Worlds to Discover:

Arcadia currently features over 50 uniquely themed scenes, each with its own mood and visual style. More scenes and mini-games are planned for future updates, expanding the world over time.

Multiplayer and Shared Play:

Arcadia offers real-time online modes where up to 15 players can compete, as well as dedicated two-player ranking modes for friends. These modes add a social layer while keeping the core gameplay calm and accessible.

Progression and Collectibles:

By completing levels, players earn stars that can be used in an in-game building system. These stars allow you to unlock and place beautiful furniture to decorate your room. Hidden Easter eggs throughout the game also unlock a collection of exclusive 3D figurines, encouraging players to explore carefully and enjoy the experience beyond simply finding differences.

Accessibility and Inclusive Design:

Arcadia is designed so visual differences are never based on color alone. Differences can be identified through shape, lighting, texture, or placement. A colorblind-friendly mode improves contrast and visual clarity, helping make the game more comfortable for players with color vision differences.

Universal Appeal:

With moderate difficulty, intuitive controls, and support for multiple global languages, Arcadia is suitable for players of different ages, backgrounds, and experience levels.
